text:
Anya: spotted an Azure blob in partner-shared (https://blob.core.windows.net/partner-shared/ci/workspace_wrap.bin) that starts with `vault:transit:v1:`. Partner-SP had blob read access.
sec-bot: Alert: azure-blob-external-read detected (rule: azure-tenant-external-access). Created incident 3680012345.
Devon: paste blob uri + first ~80 chars (no secrets) so we can fingerprint wrapper.
Anya: https://blob.core.windows.net/partner-shared/ci/workspace_wrap.bin -> header (sanitized): `vault:transit:v1:9b3d...e2f` then `az-kv:uri=https://kv-prod.vault.azure.net/keys/abcd` inside metadata.
Ravi: that looks like a nested envelope (Vault transit + Azure Key Vault reference). Blast radius bigger if SP could orchestrate both unwraps.
Alyssa: do we still have the federated SP we gave for partner onboarding? I recall an app identity with contributor-ish perms for artifact uploads.
Anya: yes - service principal partner-app@partner-tenant had role assignment Storage Blob Data Reader on the container (expires 2026-08).
Devon: containment checklist: 1) remove role assignment 2) revoke SP client secret and federated credentials 3) quarantine blob to secure storage 4) enable/ensure Azure Monitor logs for Key Vault and our Vault transit audit are retained 90+ days.
Oncall: executing revocation now. Commands: \n  # remove role assignment\n  az role assignment delete --assignee-object-id <partner-sp-object-id> --scope /subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/infra/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/partnerstorage/blobServices/default/containers/ci\n  # revoke SP secret\n  az ad sp credential delete --id <partner-sp-id> --key-id <cred-id>
Anya: quarantining blob to secure container and deleting original.
  az storage blob copy start --account-name secstore --destination-container quarantine --source-uri "https://blob.core.windows.net/partner-shared/ci/workspace_wrap.bin"
  az storage blob delete --account-name partnerstorage --container-name ci --name workspace_wrap.bin
Ravi: enable detailed audits:
  # Vault transit audit (on-host)
  vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_transit_audit.log
  # Azure Key Vault diagnostic settings -> Log analytics / storage account
  az monitor diagnostic-settings create --resource /subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/infra/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/kv-prod --workspace <log-analytics-id> --logs "[{\"category\":\"AuditEvent\",\"enabled\":true}]"
Devon: rotation plan: 1) forced rotate Vault transit key 2) rewrap affected blobs we control 3) check Azure Key Vault for any decrypt/key unwrap operations tied to partner principals and rotate Azure keys if we see suspicious activity 4) tighten RBAC so partner SP cannot call vault-proxy endpoints.
Alyssa: scanning partner containers for `vault:transit:` prefixes now. Running: \n  az storage blob list --account-name partnerstorage --container-name ci --query "[].name" | xargs -I {} az storage blob download --account-name partnerstorage --container-name ci --name {} --file /tmp/{} && head -c 64 /tmp/{} | strings | grep "vault:transit" || true
Anya: found 4 blobs with `vault:transit:` prefix across partner-shared and partner-artifacts. Uploaded scrubbed list to /sec/artifacts/3680012345-list.txt.
Ravi: check Azure Key Vault access logs for UnwrapKey/Decrypt operations referencing that key uri. Example Cloud query: \n  az monitor activity-log list --filters "resourceUri eq '/subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/infra/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/kv-prod'" --start-time 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z
Devon: if logs show partner SP made Unwrap/Decrypt calls, we will rotate the Key Vault key (create new key, update services). Note: Key Vault key rotation will not rewrap existing external ciphertexts; we need to re-encrypt at the data-owner side or mark artifacts invalid.
Oncall: started canary rotate in staging: \n  vault write -f transit/keys/app-transit-key/rotate ; vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext="vault:transit:v1:9b3d..." key="app-transit-key"
Devon: also tighten Vault proxy: ensure API gateway requires internal mTLS and restrict partner client certs. Update policy so transit/unwrap only allowed for internal-service entity IDs. Sample HCL change: \n  path "transit/encrypt/*" { capabilities = ["update"] }\n  path "transit/decrypt/*" { capabilities = ["deny"] }\n  path "transit/unwrap" { capabilities = ["update"] # allow only for "service=build-service" }
Anya: notified partner SOC/legal with scrubbed artifact keys and actions taken. Partner requested timeline and confirmation of deletion. Legal: please prepare standard partner notification template.
Legal: on it. Provide sanitized list + containment evidence (az commands + copy checksums).
Ravi: preliminary audit slice shows no successful KV Unwraps by partner-SP, only failed attempts (401/403) on 2026-03-21T18:12Z. Still proceeding with full rotation and rewrap.
Alyssa: rewrap completed for 4 blobs we control; rotation propagated. Quarantined copies checksummed and proof uploaded to incident ticket.
Oncall: scheduling 60-min post-rotation review 2026-03-24 15:00 UTC to validate logs, rewrap proofs, RBAC changes, and KMS decisions.
Devon: action owners: Anya (artifact scan + quarantine proofs), Ravi (transit rotate + KV audit), Alyssa (rewrap ops), Oncall (revocation proof), Legal (partner comms).
Anya: running an overnight tenant-wide scan for any other partner-shared containers with vault markers; will post results tomorrow morning.
Ravi: nice catch team. Keep updates here and paste sanitized audit snippets into the ticket. :lock:
